text: Opening a savings account requires a citizenship certificate and one passport-size photo. The minimum opening balance is NPR 500. KYC must be completed within 30 days of opening.
The daily ATM withdrawal limit is NPR 50,000. Debit card replacement costs NPR 300. Replacement cards are delivered within 7 working days.
The personal loan interest rate is 12% per annum. The maximum loan tenure is 5 years. Applicants must submit 6 months of salary statements. The processing fee is 1% of the loan amount.
Mobile banking transfers up to NPR 100,000 per day. Transfers within Everest Digital Bank are free; transfers to other banks cost NPR 10.
The helpline 01-5550000 is open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Sunday to Friday. You can also email support@everestbank.com.np.
If your card is lost or stolen, report it immediately through the mobile app or the helpline. The card is blocked instantly after the report.
Savings accounts earn 5% interest per annum, paid quarterly.
